name: Yuki
about: Yuki is a Japanese given name whose meaning depends on the kanji used. 幸 can mean 'happiness' or 'good fortune,' while 雪 means 'snow.' Used across genders, Yuki combines a soft sound with associations ranging from winter landscapes to happiness and good fortune.

name: Yuu
about: Yuu is a Japanese given name whose meaning varies with the kanji used. 優 can express excellence or gentleness, 悠 can suggest permanence or calm, and 勇 means 'brave.' Used across genders, Yuu is a concise name whose written form allows different qualities and meanings to shape its identity.

name: Yu
about: Yu is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 玉 can mean 'jade' or 'gem,' 愉 can mean 'pleasant' or 'happy,' while 雨 means 'rain.' Used across genders, Yu is an exceptionally concise name with several distinct natural and positive interpretations.

name: Yun
about: Yun is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 云 and 雲 mean 'cloud,' creating an association with the open sky, while 允 can express the ideas of allowing or consenting. Used across genders, Yun is a compact name with an airy natural interpretation.

name: Yūki
about: Yūki is a Japanese given name represented by several possible kanji combinations. Depending on the characters, meanings can include excellence, gentleness, courage, hope and other positive qualities. Used across genders, the macron represents the long vowel in Japanese romanisation and preserves an important distinction in written form.

name: Yona
about: Yona is the Hebrew form of Jonah and is associated with the Hebrew word for 'dove.' The dove has long carried associations with peace, gentleness and hope. Used across genders in modern Hebrew, Yona is a distinctive gender-neutral name with ancient roots and a peaceful natural image.

name: Yuval
about: Yuval is the modern Hebrew form of the biblical name Jubal. In the Hebrew Bible, Jubal is described as an ancestor of those who play the lyre and pipe, giving the name a longstanding association with music and creative expression. Used across genders in modern Hebrew, Yuval is a distinctive name connecting ancient tradition with contemporary usage.

name: Yarden
about: Yarden is the Hebrew form of Jordan, the name of the river that flows through the Levant. The river has deep historical and cultural significance in the region and gives the name a strong connection with water and landscape. Used across genders in modern Hebrew, Yarden is a globally recognisable name with Hebrew roots.

name: Yancy
about: Yancy is an English-language surname-derived given name with established use for more than one gender. The surname developed from an Americanized Dutch family name and became associated with American naming traditions. Distinctive yet approachable, Yancy provides a Western surname-name option with a relaxed modern character.

name: Yahav
about: Yahav is a modern Hebrew name meaning 'hope.' Its concise form and uplifting meaning give it a contemporary character while grounding it in Hebrew language and naming culture. Used across genders, Yahav is a distinctive gender-neutral name centred on optimism and possibility.

name: Yağmur
about: Yağmur is a Turkish and Azerbaijani name meaning 'rain.' Its direct connection to nature gives it associations with renewal, growth and life-giving water. Used across genders, Yağmur is a distinctive international nature name.

name: Yali
about: Yali is a Hebrew name meaning 'my God.' It is a compact and contemporary-sounding name with deep Hebrew roots and a clear spiritual meaning. Used across genders, Yali provides a concise international option.

name: Yalwa
about: Yalwa is a Hausa name meaning 'abundance.' Its positive meaning connects it with prosperity, plenty and flourishing. Used across genders, Yalwa adds a distinctive West African name and cultural perspective to the collection.

name: Yamikani
about: Yamikani is a Chewa name associated with the meaning 'be grateful' or 'praise.' It carries a positive virtue-based meaning centred on gratitude and appreciation. Used across genders, Yamikani adds strong Chewa and southeastern African representation.

name: Yanick
about: Yanick is a Breton and French diminutive associated with Yann and Yanna, ultimately related to John and its meaning 'God is gracious.' Its use across masculine and feminine forms gives it a distinctly European gender-neutral character.

name: Yusri
about: Yusri is an Arabic-derived name used in Malay and Indonesian naming traditions and associated with meanings including 'comfort,' 'ease' and 'prosperity.' Its positive meaning gives it associations with a peaceful and flourishing life. Used across genders, Yusri provides broad cultural reach.

name: Yuli
about: Yuli is a modern Hebrew name associated with the month of July. Its connection with midsummer gives it warm associations with sunshine, summer and the natural world. Used across genders, Yuli is short, approachable and internationally accessible.

name: Yarrow
about: Yarrow is an English botanical name taken from the yarrow plant, a flowering herb with a long history of traditional medicinal and folkloric associations. As a nature name it has a distinctly earthy character and works naturally as a gender-neutral choice.

name: Yale
about: Yale is a Welsh and English surname and place-name choice. The name is associated with the Welsh place-name Iâl and has a strong surname-style character when used as a given name. Its compact form and lack of an inherently gendered meaning make it suitable as a modern gender-neutral option.

name: Yule
about: Yule is an English word name associated with the winter festival and the Christmas season. Its seasonal meaning gives it strong associations with winter, celebration, warmth and renewal. Used across genders, Yule provides a distinctive English word-name option.
